items: Powdered sugar and milk, to desired sweetness and consistency
Your favorite ingredients for the egg scramble

steps.title: Add the sugar and butter
steps.body: Add to: **½ cup sugar**, **1½ tsp salt** and **½ cup butter, melted**.

steps.title: Add yeast and eggs
steps.body: Cool to lukewarm and add: **2 tsp yeast**, **½ cup lukewarm water**, **2 large eggs** and **4 cups flour**.

steps.title: Knead the dough
steps.body: Mix and knead the dough, until it's soft and smooth. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.

steps.title: Divide the dough
steps.body: Next day, divide dough into about 20 golf ball sized pieces.

steps.title: Flatten and rest
steps.body: Flatten the balls until they're about ½-inch thick, and allow them to rest for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Make sweet kolaches
steps.body: For sweet kolaches: Using your fingers, make a wide, deep indentation in the center of each flattened dough ball. Don't be afraid of being decisive here; you want to make a deep enough indentation that it doesn't just disappear as the buns rise and bake. Top with about 1 Tbsp cream cheese mixture (cream cheese + powdered sugar + milk to desired sweetness and consistency; **4 oz cream cheese** per recipe) then with 1 Tbsp of a favorite jam or lemon curd (mmmm).

steps.title: Make savory kolaches
steps.body: For savory kolaches: Cook up an egg scramble with your favorite ingredients (about **a dozen eggs**, **1 lb meat** and **2 cups cheese** per recipe). Add the cheese halfway through, and leave the scramble slightly wet. Roll out dough a little flatter (larger) than for the sweet kolaches, place 1-2 Tbsp of the egg scramble in the dough, and pull edges around to form a ball. Place on baking pan, seam side down. Bake as other kolaches, then brush with butter after baking.

steps.title: Rise
steps.body: Then, cover the kolaches, and allow them to rise for about an hour (they won't necessarily double in bulk).

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 350°F for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
